profile.input_contract: JSON point-kinetics parameters with reactivity, precursor0, steps, and dt.
profile.output_contract: JSON observables t, power, precursor, and scalar power_extrema.
profile.adapter: Cloud-safe Python runner and JSON parser/adapter under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p5/.

mrs.description: P5 point-kinetics live launcher slice: scaling the source reactivity by factor > 1 increases the deterministic power_extrema summary while preserving the imported observable names t, power, precursor, and power_extrema.

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: larger reactivity produces a larger deterministic power_extrema summary in this P5 live-launcher surrogate.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField at /params/reactivity with factor > 1; all other point-kinetics inputs remain fixed.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe scalar `power_extrema`; the runner also emits imported observables `t`, `power`, and `precursor` for provenance parity.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks that follow-up power_extrema is larger than source power_extrema.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable to the cloud-safe Minimum-MR-SubSet P5 surrogate sample under SUT/minimum_mr_subset_p5/sample/canonical.json.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates that the P5 runtime promotion, adapter mapping, or monotonic power-response contract disagrees with the staged import metadata.
